# v1.2.6

The addition of Vambrace kinda completely broke many of the assumptions I made in my system, luckily it wasn't too difficult to revamp the thing, and I added the enhanced books while I was at it.

On a separate note the inventory scanner is coming along slowly (mostly because I have no clue what I'm doing) but surely.

## New features

- Vambrace has been added, but with no juice or special usage
  - This is because I don't know how much each juice / special costs. If you have this data, please let me know via [Discord](https://discord.gg/KWDpQyvgzc) or [GitHub](https://github.com/Kenivia/Honing-Forecast)!
- Enhanced 19-20 books have been added
  - Auto market price fetching doesn't work with this as loa-buddy hasn't added this yet. They are both defaulted to 15,000 gold for now, you can modify them yourself.
  - Smile Gate couldn't be bothered to draw a new icon, so I've taken some creative liberty

## Fixes & improvements

- Various backend improvements to accomodate the existence of Vambrace:
  - It can now take an arbitrary number of piece types (not just armor & weapon)
  - Available juices are no longer assumed to be just a pair of juice and book (it can be an arbitrary selection out of any number of pools, which allows for multiple types of books)
- Various fixes of graphs
- Settings loading / parsing should now be much more robust
